description: This file defines the AppSearchController class, which manages search-related state and interactions for a Flutter-based frontend. It handles querying content, managing recents, cache invalidation, and communicates with data repositories and cache services.

classes.name: AppSearchController
classes.description: A controller class extending ChangeNotifier to manage search state, results, recents, and interactions with cache and data repository.

methods.name: loadRecent
methods.description: Loads recent searches from cache and database, updates internal state, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the current search query and clears previous error messages.

methods.name: _persistRecent
methods.description: Persists a search query to cache and database for recent searches.

methods.name: _runQuery
methods.description: Performs a search query using the repository, updates results, handles recents, and manages loading state.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles the user submitting a search, initiates a query, and manages loading/error state.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Re-executes the current query from cache to refresh results.

methods.name: clearRecent
methods.description: Clears the recent searches from cache and database, then reloads.
